name: mars1-fixtures
description: Golden Mars 1 .ifs bitstreams that validate docs/mars1-format.md (Step 3).

variants.label: alfa5
variants.description: -A 5: a 5-bit scale quantiser, so a leaf is not a whole number of nibbles

variants.label: min2
variants.description: -m 2: drives the partition below the pyramidal decoder's floor (D11)

variants.label: max32
variants.description: -M 32: leaves above 16, and one fewer level of forced subdivision

variants.label: walkthrough
variants.description: -m 16 -M 32 on tiny64: the 24-byte file dissected in mars1-format.md §12

groups.label: grid
groups.description: Every fixture image at the 1998 settings, three methods, three rates. The rates bracket the Step 2 sweep (2 = deep partition, 32 = shallow and mostly DC-only), so the golden set contains leaves at every size and both leaf kinds.

groups.label: header-stress
groups.description: The header's variable-width fields and the derived bit widths, which the default point never varies. Run on the two non-power-of-two images (where bits_per_coordinate truncation and sub-min_size leaves both bite) plus lena.

groups.label: walkthrough
groups.description: The one bitstream small enough to print in full.
